{{Quote|General, there's a fleet of Star Destroyers coming out of hyperspace in sector four.|General Rieekan receives a report from a controller|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Sector Four''' was a location within the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. Shortly prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in Sector Four. Their arrival was detected by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] controllers in the command center of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="AoH" />
